image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a textured, grey rocky surface. The salamander displays characteristic glossy black skin with irregular, vivid yellow patches and spots. Its body is robust and cylindrical, with short, stout limbs visible. The head is broad, and the tail extends towards the right edge of the frame. The lighting highlights the moist, glandular texture of the skin.
